artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the book spines is nonsensical, blurred, and malformed. Characters do not form real words, and the typography melts into the background colors, a classic AI generation artifact.

artifact_observations.location: Right side of the middle shelf / junction with vertical support
artifact_observations.reasoning: The vertical support on the right side seems to merge ambiguously with the shelf and the background wall. The geometry of the corner is unclear, and objects on the shelf seem to float or merge with the edge rather than resting firmly on it.
The texture of the book pages and covers lacks fine detail. They appear smudged and painterly rather than having distinct paper edges and cover textures.
The perspective lines of the shelves and the back panel do not converge consistently. The right side of the bookcase seems to warp outward or detach from the logical plane of the left side.

To check for fusion between books and shelves, and to verify if the books are distinct, separate objects or melted together.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on book spines
Physical contact points between books and shelves (floating/fusion)
Geometric consistency of shelf alignment and vertical supports
Texture realism of wood grain and paper
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's findings. If the text is completely gibberish, this is a strong signal of AI generation regardless of the overall shape. Also, verify if the 'structural collapse' on the right is a real physical ambiguity or just poor lighting/angle. The lack of symmetry should not be penalized as an artifact, but the melting of objects into each other should be.
